root_cause: The daily conversion planner treated growth_page_daily.page_views as verified human traffic while the independent 28-day growth_events contained 16,850 robot-labelled and 5,434 non-robot page_view events, with the last non-robot raw view on 2026-10-06 despite daily rollups through 2026-10-23. The single CTA click was last observed 2026-10-01. A zero daily CTA count cannot establish human page abandonment.
fix: Within existing scheduled Growth Intelligence, observe a bounded non-identifying sample of non-bot pageview timestamps. The CRO planner explicitly removes unverified CTA-rate denominators and emits measurement-evidence-gap recommendations instead of low-CTA copy conclusions; independent GSC signals remain eligible for research. No new tracker or schedule; existing PR #4819 owns CTA instrumentation.
prevention_rules: Never treat a mixed or unproven page rollup as a human conversion denominator.
Measure page-view and primary CTA cohort parity before diagnosing specific visitor abandonment reasons.
Exclude robots from conversion observations and reject future-dated or stale raw human event probes.
Preserve existing CTA instrumentation owner PR #4819 and do not introduce a duplicate tracker or scheduler.
Keep independent GSC SEO opportunities visible even if CRO cohort measurements remain unverified.
Only protected release plus first-party, provider-observed human-only conversion funnel can authorize changing a CRO performance status from unknown to proved.
terminal_rule: Pass canonical replay, Required, CodeQL, Netlify build, protected merge and production readback. Planner release must not be claimed as proven conversion improvement or revenue.
